cohorts.rollback: Rebuild and deploy with -PreaderUiDirectoryPilotEnabled=false. BuildConfig.READER_UI_DIRECTORY_PILOT_ENABLED then routes the pair through the native reducer exactly once and retains runtime shadow observation; the rollback test locks this behavior.

knownDifferences.description: ReaderUIRuntime 2.5.1 covers 35 events: 7 are in three production Pilot cohorts (directory, book.open, and TTS/auto-page), while the remaining 28 events are default-Shadow. Import, source-switch, replace-rule, RSS, and Sync coordinator/executor implementations are dormant experimental seams only: production does not call their Pilot dispatch functions or construct their effect executors, and all five BuildConfig flags default to false.
knownDifferences.exitCriteria: Promote a Shadow event only after production dispatch and executor wiring exist, exactly-once Core/Host ownership and native de-duplication are proven, rollback tests are green, and physical-device evidence is recorded.
